limitations: This script does not train models, alter Stage03, modify splits, or overwrite existing evaluation artifacts.
Stage 03 targets are the mean of valid finite malignancy_reader_ratings selected by malignancy_reader_mask; malignancy_median and malignancy_reader_count are not used as targets.
Stage 03 train features are in-sample predictions, so train-split feature diagnostics may be optimistic.
Held-out test results are reported for evaluation only and must not be used for model selection or tuning.
Reader ratings are not pathology-confirmed malignancy labels.
Only the six features in manifest order (subtlety, sphericity, margin, lobulation, spiculation, texture) are used.

observations.observation: Stage03 model predictions after nearest-integer rounding and clipping are concentrated in one rating.
Stage03 model predictions after nearest-integer rounding and clipping are concentrated in one rating.
Distribution shift metrics compare XML reader-level rows against Stage03 nodule-level rows; these are not paired samples and aggregation differences confound direct causal interpretation.

hypotheses_not_established: Feature-distribution mismatch may contribute, but this report alone does not establish causality.
Reader-level target construction and nodule-level archive target aggregation may differ; upstream scripts and archive target provenance are required to establish equivalence.
A nearly constant model response can also arise from feature order/preprocessing mismatch, weak fitted signal, target imbalance, or out-of-range/invalid values.
